name: Vercel
subtitle: Frontend cloud and serverless platform
creator: Guillermo Rauch (founded as ZEIT)
description: A Git-connected platform that builds and deploys frontend and full-stack JavaScript apps, with a preview URL for every push. Static assets are served from a global CDN and server code runs as serverless functions. Databases come through Marketplace partners such as Neon and Supabase.

languages.youWrite: JS/TS frameworks, with Python, Go and Ruby function runtimes; config in vercel.json

concepts.explanation: Every branch and pull request gets its own URL.
Server code that scales per request.
Postgres, Redis and more from partners.

codeSamples.label: Shell
codeSamples.code:
npm i -g vercel && vercel   # deploy a preview
vercel --prod               # promote to production

pairsWith.reason: Zero-config, built by the same team

cons: No long-running servers or background workers
No native database since Vercel Postgres ended

pricing.summary: Hobby: free for non-commercial use. Pro: $20/mo per seat, including $20 of usage credit. Enterprise: custom.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
